1.title: 概覽
content: 擁有一名英雄同時具備兩套獨立的技能組，使 ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）具備高度的適應性，能有效應對幾乎任何隊伍陣容。在智械型態（Omnic Form）下，拉瑪塔能以射程優勢壓制多數 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士（Tanks），且透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/247e18e131793da8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-accelerator-omnic-form.png)虛空加速器（Void Accelerator）（智械型態），他的遠程傷害對敵方後排構成極大威脅。

他力量的核心在於 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form），在此型態下他會獲得額外護甲，並能使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）——這是一種能穿透屏障的高傷害近戰投射物。他的遊玩風格圍繞在於智械型態下消耗敵方的生命值與資源，接著在敵方最脆弱時變身為復仇型態發動突擊。如果敵方隊伍缺乏暈眩或擊退技能，![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation）往往是能左右戰局的絕招。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）是你的核心力量，它能強化你的進攻能力與生存力。請務必等到敵人進入 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重擊（Pummel，復仇型態）的攻擊範圍內再開啟。

* 請保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）配合 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）使用，以緩速敵人並防止他們逃脫。

* 在復仇型態結束後立即啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation），以最大化你的生存能力並延長復仇型態的持續時間。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔在智械型態下較不耐打，威脅性也較低。當復仇型態結束後，就是你發動攻勢的最佳時機。

* 阻斷他的絕招視野（LoS）可以快速終結該技能。只要讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation）的範圍傷害效果中斷累計 3 秒，該技能就會立即取消。
* 如果拉瑪塔正朝你走來，請提防他的渦流（Vortex）。在他投擲該技能前，請利用位移技能或掩體進行防備。

2.title: 優缺點總結
content: * 高生存率
* 優異的衝鋒能力
* 混合（Hybrid）英雄
* 明顯的冷卻時間循環
* 被控場（CC）技能剋制
* 巨大的受擊判定範圍（Hurtbox）

3.1.1.title: 高生存能力
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）在啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）時會獲得 300 點額外護甲，這也包含在他的絕招期間。他可以在整個復仇型態持續期間進行格擋，並在智械型態（Omnic Form）下部署一個高生命值的屏障。綜合這些能力，使他具備卓越的耐戰力與強大的拖延潛力。

3.1.2.title: 擅長突進壓制
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）會賦予額外移動速度，而 ![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）則能施加緩速效果，讓拉瑪塔（Ramattra）能夠有效地突進並壓制目標。當他拉近距離後，重拳（Pummel）的穿透護盾傷害能確保擊殺。

3.1.3.title: 多功能的混合型配置
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）可以在鬥毆（brawl）、衝鋒（rush）和消耗（poke）陣容中發揮作用。智械型態（Omnic Form）能以遠程傷害對高台和後排造成壓力，而 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）則能進行前線鬥毆。

3.2.1.title: 明顯的冷卻時間循環
content: 拉瑪塔（Ramattra）使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png) 復仇型態（Nemesis Form）的時機往往顯得非常可預測，且容易被對手針對。當敵方擁有足夠的機動性來風箏復仇型態時，拉瑪塔將難以替隊伍創造價值。

3.2.2.title: 被控場技能反制
content: 每當拉瑪塔（Ramattra）開啟復仇型態（Nemesis Form）時，就像是在身上掛了一個巨大的「快來暈我」招牌。他沒有任何手段能阻擋像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）或裂地重擊（Shatter）這類暈眩效果。此外，由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）的攻擊距離很短，擊退技能也能同樣有效地壓制復仇型態。

3.2.3.title: 巨大的受擊判定與極少的護盾
content: 雖然拉瑪塔（Ramattra）憑藉著「格擋（Block）」和護甲擁有極高的生存能力，但他也很容易變成對手的「絕招充能包」。他龐大的身軀讓像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞（Freja）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)索潔恩（Sojourn）這類英雄，能夠利用拉瑪塔來為他們的武器補充彈藥。其他人則可以利用他來快速累積絕招能量。在「復仇女神（Nemesis）」型態下，他會成為遠程英雄的活靶子；而「智械型態（Omnic Form）」則很容易讓近戰英雄發動猛烈攻勢。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：虛空加速器（Void Accelerator）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/247e18e131793da8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-accelerator-omnic-form.png)虛空加速器（Omnic Form）的使用技巧
* 遠程消耗

* * 在進入 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Nemesis Form）的攻擊範圍之前，你應該始終盡可能地使用主要攻擊進行消耗。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/247e18e131793da8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-accelerator-omnic-form.png)虛空加速器（Omnic Form）也非常適合用來爭奪高地，因為你本身沒有任何垂直位移能力。
* 誘餌

* * 利用智械型態作為誘餌來引誘敵人，同時保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)重拳（Nemesis Form）。一旦敵人靠近，如果他們投入了大量資源（例如使用絕招），請使用渦流（Vortex）和護盾來保護自己，然後再切換至重拳（Nemesis Form）。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：虛空屏障（Void Barrier）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/18b39bbccad34011.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-barrier-omnic-form.png)虛空屏障（Void Barrier）（智械型態）的使用技巧
* 協助隊伍進行消耗戰
* * 不要只為了自保而使用屏障；尋找機會，在屏障的保護下為隊友創造探頭並進行擊殺的契機。
* 切斷敵方坦克（Tank）的連結

* * 每當敵方![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank）衝在隊伍前方時，就在他們身後部署屏障。這樣他們將無法獲得治療，也無法得到隊友的火力支援來對我方隊伍施壓。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：復仇型態（Nemesis Form）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）的使用技巧**
* 應對敵方的進攻手段

* 若沒有 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form），你將無法在敵方激進的攻勢與突襲下存活。當你預判敵方試圖快速推進時，請保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form），直到他們將關鍵技能投入戰鬥中。
* 強化你的進攻能力

![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）會將拉瑪塔轉變為巨大的威脅。你可以交替使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）與格擋（Block）來承受傷害，同時利用提升後的移動速度來佔據空間並攻擊敵方後排。

4.4.title: （在復仇型態期間）主要攻擊：重拳（Pummel）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）的技巧**
* 反制傷害減免

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）可以穿透屏障以及傷害吸收技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)動能補捉（Kinetic Grasp）。

* 針對那些使用這些技能來保命的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank），請等到他們已經受到一些傷害後，再使用復仇型態的 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）來持續施壓，同時他們正試圖保護自己。
* 近戰纏鬥

* * 無論你是在與 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank）、輸出（DPS）還是 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Support）單挑，![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態）都是你與目標近戰纏鬥時的首選方式。每次攻擊帶來的連續爆發傷害，能在大多數敵人對你龐大的生命值造成顯著消耗前，就將他們擊殺。

4.5.title: （復仇型態期間）次要攻擊：格擋
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/a6b525622400ef12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblock-nemesis-form.png)格擋（復仇型態）的技巧**
* 拖延時間

* * 利用你的護甲與傷害減免來![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克敵方傷害並拖延目標點。在延長賽中，你可以為隊友爭取從重生點趕回來的時間。在戰鬥過程中，你可以吸收敵方傷害並延長戰鬥時間。
* 掌握敵方攻擊時機

* * 拉瑪塔可以在面對攻擊速度較慢的敵人（如![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬與![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特）時，在重擊（Nemesis Form）之間穿插格擋。在對方每次主要攻擊時進行格擋，然後使用![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重擊（復仇型態）一到兩次，以在造成傷害的同時將自身受到的傷害降至最低。
* 身體阻擋
* * 由於你的屏障只有一次使用機會，拉瑪塔保護隊友的另一種方式就是站在他們面前並保持格擋。

* 在輸出型英雄施放絕招時保護他們，或是當![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援型英雄遭到集火時保護他們。

4.6.title: [E]：飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）的使用技巧
* 緩速敵人
* 當敵人試圖向你推進時，使用飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）來減緩他們的進攻。為自己爭取時間，以避開敵方持續性技能（例如引導型絕招）的影響時間。
* 衝鋒陷陣
* 利用復仇型態（Nemesis）的移動速度加成來追擊目標。
* 將飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）留給復仇型態（Nemesis）使用，因為大多數英雄無法透過位移技能逃離漩渦，飛行單位會被拉向地面，且緩速效果能讓他們持續處於你的重拳（Pummel）攻擊範圍內。

4.7.title: 絕招：殲滅（Annihilation）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation）的使用技巧**
* 小心控場技能

* * 在發動 ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation）期間，敵方知道拉瑪塔無法使用屏障，且很容易受到控場技能（CC）影響。如果你被擊退或受到長時間的暈眩，你的絕招會迅速結束。

* 如果敵方有像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）這類會中斷你絕招的技能，請先使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）來逼出該技能，隨後再立即施放絕招。
* 延長持續時間

* * 只要至少有一名敵人在 ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)殲滅（Annihilation）的範圍效果（AoE）內，絕招就不會結束（最長可達 20 秒）。重點在於利用格擋（Block）保持生存，並將敵人留在範圍內。
* 你也可以在敵方隊伍中間發動絕招，迫使他們為了逃跑而向四面八方散開。接著，鎖定離你隊伍最近的那名敵人進行快速擊殺。

5.1.1.title: 虛空湧動（Void Surge）
5.1.1.description: 虛空加速器（Void Accelerator）在持續射擊期間，會週期性地額外發射 6 發投射物。
content: * 強化拉瑪塔（Ramattra）的弱點

* 額外爆發傷害的影響力比帳面數據看起來更大。此外，與延長屏障（Prolonged Barrier）相比，![](/data/assets/guide/18b39bbccad34011.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-barrier-omnic-form.png)虛空屏障（Void Barrier）（智械型態）永遠不會破碎，多出一秒的時間也很難造成改變戰局的差異。

* 在智械型態（Omnic Form）下擁有更好的傷害，讓拉瑪塔在等待![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）冷卻時能更具威脅性。

5.1.2.title: 無情型態
5.1.2.description: 當拉瑪塔處於復仇型態（Nemesis Form）時，擊殺敵人可延長該型態持續時間 1 秒。
content: * 拉瑪塔的大部分價值皆來自於 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）。能夠延長持續時間是非常強大的效果。雖然你無法保證每次都能擊殺敵人，但一旦成功觸發，這將會是一個影響力極大的增益效果。

5.2.1.title: 奈米修復（Nanite Repair）
5.2.1.description: 當拉瑪塔（Ramattra）處於貪婪漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）範圍內時，每秒可恢復 75 點生命值。
content: * 提供額外的續航力
* 當拉瑪塔（Ramattra）在貪婪漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）內待滿完整持續時間，總共可恢復 150 點生命值。

* 在近距離纏鬥時非常實用，因為你可以將貪婪漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）丟在腳下，並在留在範圍內的同時使用重拳（Pummel）攻擊敵人 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士（Bruiser）。

5.2.2.title: 宿怨漩渦（Vengeful Vortex）
5.2.2.description: 當飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）在空中時，再次按下 E 鍵即可引爆，造成 50 點傷害並將敵人向下拉扯。
content: * 更適合消耗戰
* 能夠在空中引爆漩渦，讓你可以輕鬆捕捉遠處的敵人，而無需追求完美的落點。50 點的引爆傷害也有助於提升你的消耗戰殺傷力。
* 更強的突擊能力
* 當追擊敵人時，將漩渦射在他們前方並引爆，強迫他們穿過漩渦。這使得突擊目標變得顯著容易。

6.title: 地圖
content: 適合近距離交戰、目標區域較小，且幾乎沒有高台的地圖最適合拉瑪塔。他希望敵人能保持足夠近的距離，以便隨時能使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）發動突擊。此外，由於他具備良好的水平移動速度，但缺乏垂直機動性，因此平坦的地形最能發揮拉瑪塔的遊玩風格。對於拉瑪塔而言，視野開闊且視線距離長的地圖在某些對戰組合下會顯得較為吃力。

如果敵方陣容多為短程英雄與 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank），他便佔有優勢；但若敵方使用長程或高機動性英雄，他則處於劣勢。他不希望浪費時間試圖接近敵人，而高台也讓敵人能輕易逃離他的復仇型態與絕招。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 圍繞 ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）建立的隊伍陣容，可以在他全力進攻時進行跟隨與協助。由於拉瑪塔會獲得移動速度加成，並立即成為敵方隊伍的集火目標，他將會承受敵方大量的傷害與冷卻技能。

他的護甲與格擋（Block）能幫助他存活下來，但若想發揮最大價值，他需要隊友協助治療，這樣他才能使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)重拳（Pummel）（復仇型態（Nemesis Form））來攻擊敵人並取得擊殺。他的屏障（Barrier）能為狙擊手與遠程盟友提供短暫的保護，但由於冷卻時間較長，無法作為長期依賴的手段。
任何能為他提供額外速度加成的隊友，都能極大程度地幫助他繞過前線並快速擊殺脆皮英雄。
**圍繞拉瑪塔建立的隊伍陣容範例：**

![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔、![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）、![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)士兵76、![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光、![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)朱諾、![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人協同效應
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光

* ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光與拉瑪塔組隊時的目標，是負責處理他最強大的剋星：![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜。![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光會讓![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的日子非常難過，因為她唯一能對付![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光的希望，就是命中那發高難度的![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）。如果她真的命中了，那就是拉瑪塔發動「復仇型態」與![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)絕滅（Annihilation）的訊號，因為他知道自己可以放心向前衝鋒，不必擔心被睡。大多數時候，![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光都能對![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜造成足夠的干擾，使她無法對拉瑪塔構成威脅。當兩人配合默契時，拉瑪塔的「貪婪漩渦」（Vortex）能讓![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光更容易完成彈匣清空擊殺以及命中![](/data/assets/guide/4179aa31d749fae6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulse-bomb.png)脈衝炸彈（Pulse Bomb）。
![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)朱諾

* ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)超速環（Hyper Ring）是拉瑪塔希望隊伍中有![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)朱諾的主要原因。拉瑪塔不需要持續性的加速，他只需要在準備衝鋒的精確瞬間獲得額外速度。![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)朱諾可以將![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)超速環留給拉瑪塔每次衝鋒時使用，這樣他就能橫掃所有人。與路西歐相比，她也能更輕鬆地治療並維持拉瑪塔的生存。
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子

* 拉瑪塔容易受到負面效果、擊退和昏迷的影響。保護鈴（Suzu）可以反制所有這些效果，並讓拉瑪塔能成功對抗他的剋星。在![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸衝刺（Kitsune Rush）期間的復仇型態，對拉瑪塔來說簡直就像擁有第二個絕招。更快的移動和攻擊速度意味著敵人被迫嘗試逃跑，因此當雙方都需要爭奪目標區域時，這是一個致命的組合。

8.1.title: 對抗拉瑪塔（Ramattra）的通用心態
content: * 追蹤拉瑪塔（Ramattra）的「復仇女神型態（Nemesis Form）」冷卻時間，並在他較無威脅的「智械型態（Omnic Form）」期間進行懲罰。
* 保留位移技能以閃避「虛無（Vortex）」。如果你已經被困在「虛無（Vortex）」中，請在脫離範圍前不要使用位移技能。

* Break LoS during ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation. If you can't escape, barriers also count as breaking LoS so hold the barrier until the duration expires.
